name: postrank-explorer-engine
description: pr-core: the numerical engine of postrank Explorer (TypeScript, built to ../js/pr-core.js and ../js/pr-core.umd.js; solver bundle ../js/bundles/solver.js)
author: JoonHo Lee <jlee296@ua.edu>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/clean-outputs.mjs && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/write-dts-entry.mjs && node scripts/build-bundles.mjs && node scripts/build-solver.mjs && node scripts/write-hash.mjs
scripts.fixtures: Rscript scripts/fixtures/normal-r.R && Rscript scripts/fixtures/stream-r.R && python3 -I scripts/fixtures/erfc-mpmath.py
